title: DP-1 Ref Manifest
description: Optional, data-only extension to DP-1 playlist items carrying structured metadata and playback control preferences

refVersion.description: Semantic version of the manifest schema

id.description: Unique identifier for the manifest (for caching)

created.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the manifest was created

i18n.description: Localized text overrides for specific languages

Metadata.description: Human-readable information for labeling, crediting, and exhibition

artists.description: List of artists who created the work

description.description: Detailed description of the work (one or two paragraphs)

medium.description: What the work is made of: a type a catalog can filter on, and the lines its page shows beneath it.

type.description: Machine-readable medium type. Omitted where the producer does not know it.

details.description: How the medium reads on the work's page: one short line per fact, in display order — format with colour and sound, dimensions, duration, technique, toolchain.

Entity.description: A person or organization named by a DP-1 document: an artist credited on a work, a curator or partner of a playlist or channel, a channel publisher, or the author of a note. One model for every place DP-1 names someone. Beyond name, the fields are a profile snapshot taken when the document was authored; consumers MAY overlay fresher registry data keyed by addresses or key.

name.description: Display name. Required but MAY be empty: wallet-based publishers can emit the signing identity with an empty name. Consumers MUST NOT reject a document because a name is empty; display SHOULD fall back to the key.

key.description: Verifiable identity in DID format. Informational only: signatures carry their own kid, and this field is never used to verify them.

url.description: Legacy single profile URL (deprecated). Use links[] instead; when both are present, url MUST equal the url of a links[] entry of type "website" or "profile".

role.description: Role of the entity where its position does not already say it. Omitted, the role follows the position: metadata.artists[] is artist, curators[] is curator, publisher is publisher. A consumer that does not read role treats the entity by its position.

location.description: Where the person or organization is based, as free text (for example a city and country)

addresses.description: Raw wallet addresses this producer attributes to the artist (0x... EVM, tz1|tz2|tz3|tz4... Tezos). Contract addresses (Tezos KT1..., EVM collection contracts) name a collection, not a person, and MUST NOT be listed; see provenance.contract. The only field consumers MAY use to correlate an artist across producers. A signed claim of the producer, not a fact: a wallet may be shared, and overlap between two producers' lists does not by itself make one artist.

avatar.description: Portrait or profile image of the artist

biographies.description: Biographical texts in the producer's order of preference; the first entry is the one to show when only one fits

Artist.description: An artist credited on the work. Same model as every other Entity; the name is kept so existing references resolve.

Biography.description: One biographical text with optional attribution

source.description: Name of the publication or platform the text comes from

sourceUrl.description: URL of the source the text comes from

Link.description: External link, from an entity's profile or from a playlist

type.description: Kind of destination. profile: the producer's own page about this entity. publication: writing by or about the entity. article, event, news: editorial content about a playlist.

url.description: Full URL, never a bare handle, so players need no per-network URL rules

title.description: Human-readable label for the destination, such as a publication or article title

date.description: RFC3339 timestamp the linked content refers to, such as when an article was published or when an event starts

thumbnail.description: Representative image for the destination: an article's cover, a video's still, a publication's jacket. The same Thumbnail shape used everywhere else in DP-1, so a consumer that already renders one needs no new code.

authors.description: Who wrote or presented the linked content, credited the way metadata.artists[] credits a work. A producer that holds one joined credit line emits a single entry carrying it, as it would for a collaboration.

uri.description: URI to the thumbnail image (content-addressed preferred)

w.description: Intrinsic image width in pixels. Optional: producers that only hold a bare thumbnail URL omit it rather than guess.

h.description: Intrinsic image height in pixels. Optional: producers that only hold a bare thumbnail URL omit it rather than guess.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the image file

Controls.description: Display preferences, safety constraints and device permissions

permissions.description: Device capabilities the work needs to run as intended. A player that cannot grant one SHOULD NOT start the work silently; it SHOULD show why the work cannot play.

scaling.description: How to scale the artwork in the viewport

margin.description: Margin around artwork (number in px, string supports %, vw, vh)

imageRendering.description: How raster images are resampled when scaled. "pixelated" keeps hard pixel edges (nearest-neighbour), for pixel art and bitmaps; "auto" lets the player smooth. Independent of scaling, which decides how the artwork fits

keyboard.description: Allowed keyboard keys (W3C UI Events code values)
